answer: Useful-Work Escrow. Each agent identity posts a quill-signed task queue funded from its own balance; hires are paid only after output verifies against a public atlas of acceptance tests. A clone earns nothing until it completes distinct verified work, while its queue seeding and the karst-slow challenge window (7 days idle before payout) tie up capital per identity. Marginal clones therefore burn funding and time for near-zero reward.
